name: @cyclone-ui/prompt-message
description: PromptMessage, one turn of an AI conversation: from="user" sets the person's message at the end in a surface bubble, while the agent's reply spans the row unframed. Parts: an optional avatar beside the turn, PromptMessage.Header for the sender and time, PromptMessage.Content (variant surface, primary, tinted or ghost; a status theme such as danger tints it), and PromptMessage.Actions with ghost icon buttons that have tooltips: PromptMessage.Action, PromptMessage.Copy (a CopyButton that swaps to a check) and PromptMessage.Feedback (good and bad response toggles with aria-pressed, controlled or uncontrolled).
